name: Create age-regression fantasy duel scenarios
description: Users requested the creation of fantasy role-playing scenarios in which they played older mages or adolescents engaged in magic duels against younger children or step-siblings, specifically incorporating mechanics for age regression, stat decay, and escalating difficulty. Many requests detailed complex formulas or meters to track the user's character becoming physically and mentally younger while the opponent grew stronger.
